'''Belgar Spaceport''' was the only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Belgar]] on the planet [[Belgaroth]]. From the time of its opening, Belgaroth remained a minor waystation with a spaceport that was barely suitable for use. The spaceport’s grounds contained six [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], three warehouses, a control tower, two repair bays, and an electronic array building. Due to rains laden with [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits, most of the buildings appeared rusty and dirty. Within the spaceport stood an [[Xot's Megabar|enormous three-story]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] owned by the mysterious [[Xot (individual)|Xot]]. It was the only drinking establishment within easy walking distance of the spaceport, so everyone who landed on the planet and wanted a drink or a meal inevitably ended up in Xot’s bar. Next to the bar were two single-story buildings where [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] could spend the night for a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
The spaceport of the city of Belgar was conceived in the sourcebook [[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]] {{C|[[2003]]}} for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. The sourcebook suggested beginning one of the adventure scenarios – «An Unexpected Stop» – in Belgar Spaceport. For use in these roleplaying scenarios, the sourcebook included a map of the spaceport.
